description: List tasks in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key), across every project the account can reach, most recently changed first. Use it to answer "what am I working on", to find a task before changing it, or to catch up on what moved: pass updatedSince (ISO timestamp) for "since I last looked". Each row carries the task id that update_task and complete_task take.

agent.description: Only tasks this bot owns (its exact agentLabel, e.g. "qa-bot"), or 'none' for tasks no bot owns

assigneeId.description: Only tasks assigned to this user id, or 'none' for unassigned tasks

cursor.description: Next page: the opaque cursor a previous list_tasks reply gave you. Keep every other filter the same. Do not construct one.

dueAfter.description: Only tasks scheduled to end on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

dueBefore.description: Only tasks scheduled to end on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

limit.description: How many tasks to return (default 50, capped at 200)

openOnly.description: Leave out tasks that are done

order.description: Newest change first (default) or oldest first

projectId.description: Limit to one project (id from list_projects)

status.description: Only these workflow stage ids, e.g. ["in_progress", "on_hold"]

updatedSince.description: Only tasks changed at or after this ISO 8601 instant, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z

name: list_tasks
